title: The Fang of Abyss
summary: Ha-Jun battles the 40-foot Abyssal Void Dragon in the Colosseum of Necrothea. Dodging spatial erasure beams, he shatters the crystal prism and seizes the Fang of Abyss to turn the tide.

panels.shot: spatial breath beam tearing through arena wide shot
panels.action: The 10-meter-wide violet void beam disintegrates bone tiles, stone pillars, and air itself in a straight trench.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing supersonic evasive leap
panels.action: Ha-Jun catapults sideways into the air, the void beam deleting the afterimage of his silhouette.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aag nahi hai... Yeh space ko delete kar raha hai! Touch bhi hua toh gayab!

panels.shot: trench where beam hit erased into nothingness
panels.action: Where the beam struck, there is no rubble—only a smooth, terrifying void gap looking into empty cosmos.

panels.shot: dragon sweeping massive spiked tail
panels.action: The Void Dragon whips its 30-foot spiked obsidian tail horizontally like a high-speed freight train.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising bone gauntlet to brace
panels.action: Ha-Jun interlocks his bone gauntlet plates, preparing for the devastating kinetic impact.

panels.shot: tail impact blasting ha-jun through spectator seats
panels.action: The massive tail strikes his bone shield; Ha-Jun is blasted 80 feet through stone spectator thrones.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding to stop in stone rubble
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides to a halt among broken thrones, coughing violet dust but with his bone gauntlet unbroken.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kinetic dispersal marrow... Sach mein impact ko ground kar diya.

panels.shot: kuro diving at dragon eyes with shadow talons
panels.action: Kuro dives from the rafters, raking his sharpened shadow talons across the dragon's upper two eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: BLIND HIM! HA-JUN, GO FOR THE PRISM!

panels.shot: dragon roaring in pain, clawing at kuro
panels.action: The dragon thrashes its massive horned head, roaring as black blood leaks from its scratched eyes.

panels.shot: ha-jun vaulting out of rubble toward central pedestal
panels.action: Ha-Jun bounds across the broken stone tiers, rocketing straight toward the floating crystal prism.

panels.shot: dragon swinging front claw to crush pedestal
panels.action: Seeing Ha-Jun's target, the dragon brings its 10-foot razor-taloned foreleg down to crush the pedestal.

panels.shot: ha-jun sliding between dragon talons
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides on his knees along the bone floor, slipping mere inches between the descending dragon claws.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching floating rhomboid prism
panels.action: From directly beneath the beast, Ha-Jun leaps up to the floating 3-foot crystal prism.

panels.shot: coating right fist in concentrated hellfire
panels.action: Ha-Jun channels the full fury of the Ashen Heart into his clenched right fist: violet-crimson pyre.

panels.shot: punching the hyper-dimensional crystal prism
panels.action: Ha-Jun's flaming fist slams into the center of the void crystal with 50 tons of focused kinetic mana.

panels.shot: hyper-dimensional prism fracturing into diamonds
panels.action: The indestructible void crystal shatters into millions of glittering diamond shards.

panels.shot: the fang of abyss spinning free in midair
panels.action: The 8-inch jagged curved void dagger spins slowly in midair, radiating absolute darkness.

panels.shot: ha-jun fingers closing around the dagger hilt
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the cold, textured void-matter hilt with an audible magnetic snap.

panels.shot: spatial distortion ripples bursting from ha-jun hand
panels.action: A sphere of distorted, mirrored space ripples outward 100 meters around Ha-Jun, warping gravity.

panels.shot: system interface fanfare for relic claim
panels.action: Golden-and-violet gothic runes celebrate the bond.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC CLAIMED: THE FANG OF ABYSS (RARE)]
Rank: Rare Sovereign Class
Authority: Spatial Severance (Can slice through physical & magical barriers)
Synchronization: 42.0%.

panels.shot: ha-jun inspecting the void dagger
panels.action: Ha-Jun turns the dagger; the blade has no physical edge—it is a literal tear in the fabric of space.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh talwar nahi hai... Yeh reality mein ek chhed hai. Jo bhi chhua, woh cut ho jayega!

panels.shot: dragon turning with furious remaining eyes
panels.action: The dragon recovers, its remaining two eyes burning with apocalyptic rage as it lunges with jaws open.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing a casual midair slice with the fang
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't swing hard; he simply draws a clean, two-foot vertical line in the empty air.

panels.shot: line in empty air tearing open into a black spatial rift
panels.action: The thin line in the air tears open into a razor-thin rift of black space that expands instantly.

panels.shot: dragon lunging headfirst into the spatial rift
panels.action: The dragon's charging maw strikes the invisible spatial seam; its indestructible scales are cleaved like silk.

panels.shot: dragon skull severed cleanly along the median line
panels.action: The 40-foot beast freezes mid-lunge as a clean black line cuts through its skull and neck.

panels.shot: colossal dragon collapsing in two halves
panels.action: The colossal Void Dragon splits into two halves, crashing with thunderous finality onto the bone arena.

panels.shot: dragon body dissolving into glowing purple mist
panels.action: The monster's immense corpse dissolves into a sea of luminous purple mana mist that carpets the colosseum.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing lightly with fang of abyss in hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with effortless grace, flipping the void dagger into a reverse grip.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Fang of Abyss... It cuts through reality itself.

panels.shot: something glowing inside the severed dragon skull
panels.action: In the center of the dissolving skull, a dark celestial orb the size of an eyeball pulses with starry light.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: That light... Eye of the Night is inside the beast!
